provider: USGS Water Data for the Nation
quality_policy: Approved null/empty qualifier is unflagged; sole ESTIMATED is separately retained; absent qualifier, other qualifiers and non-Approved states are unusable for these diagnostics.
reference_quantile: Exact rational Hyndman-Fan Type 8, p=99/100; diagnostic only, not study admission.
selection: First lexicographic CAMELS gauge ID in each fixed HUC 01,03,07,10,14,17; development probes, not representative or independent units.
